audit.whatIsWrong: The content chart gives Swain all seven stages while Akshan wins 55.58% of 1050-plus games — packet.defects flags this directly — and the full layer reads 'Skill' on every row, so the two layers never agreed either.
audit.why: Swain's Death's Hand reaches 750 against Akshan's 850 Avengerang, and Swain has no dash, no blink and no shield. He does not out-range or out-trade Akshan at 1-5; his lane power is Demonic Ascension at 6 and his item sustain.
audit.corrected: Akshan takes levels 1 through 5 on range; Swain takes Level 6 and First item on drain and sustain; 2+ items returns to Akshan, who fights from outside the 650-unit drain.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every stage row was described as Swain's, so the two stages that genuinely are his were never distinguished from the five that are not.
audit.why: Demonic Ascension is a flat 120-second ultimate with 650 range that sustains indefinitely only while he is draining champions. Nevermove (E, 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s) has a shorter cooldown during Ascension, which is why level 6 and first item are his stages specifically.
audit.corrected: Level 6 = Demonic Ascension plus a faster Nevermove; First item = Ravenous Flock and DoT sustain out-healing your chip; 2+ items = your 850 range and 2500-unit Comeuppance take it back.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nevermove's return-pass root is never mentioned, Vision of Empire's stealth reveal is never mentioned, Ravenous Flock is described as something he can 'hold', and Comeuppance is called global.
audit.why: Nevermove roots on the RETURN pass, not the outgoing one, so stepping back through its path is what gets you caught — and Swain can then pull every rooted champion toward him. Vision of Empire (W, 22/21/20/19/18s, 5500-7500 range) reveals champions it hits, which strips Going Rogue's camouflage from across the map. Ravenous Flock is a passive that heals off Soul Fragments and cannot be held or spent, so Grievous Wounds, not patience, is the answer. Comeuppance has 2500 range and stops on the first champion, minion or structure hit.
audit.corrected: Sidestep Nevermove's return pass, not its cast, or he pulls you into the drain. Do not camouflage through a Vision of Empire — it reveals you outright. Buy Grievous Wounds against Ravenous Flock's Soul Fragment healing before your chip stops counting.

audit.whatIsWrong: packet flags zero sequencing cues anywhere on the matchup.
audit.why: Demonic Ascension is a flat 120s and Nevermove 12s at rank 1 — those are the two clocks worth counting.
audit.corrected: Step up on Nevermove's 12 seconds, and take the extended fight in the 120 after Demonic Ascension drops.

audit.whatIsWrong: packet flagged 'Vision of Empire's' in wants.you[0] as a suspect name.
audit.why: Vision of Empire is his real W. False positive; left unchanged.
